Für eine On-Premise-Instanz im eigenen N: For an on-premise instance on your own network, private addresses must be allowed explicitly.
GitLab ist nicht konfiguriert (Projekt-I: GitLab is not configured (project ID or API token missing).
GitLab lehnt den API-Token ab (:status): GitLab rejects the API token (:status) — please check the token.
GitLab-API antwortet mit Fehlerstatus :s: GitLab API responds with error status :status.
GitLab-Instanz, z. B. https://gitlab.com: GitLab instance, e.g. https://gitlab.com or your own on-premise address.
Importiert GitLab-Issues eines Projekts: Imports GitLab issues of a project as tasks (idempotent via iid + project ID, self-hosted instances supported): time tracking and billing in WorkDiary, GitLab stays in the lead. Polling with an updated_after checkpoint, webhook trigger optional.
Numerische GitLab-Projekt-ID (Projektsei: Numeric GitLab project ID (project page → Settings → General).
Nur für On-Premise-Instanzen im eigenen: Only for on-premise instances on your own network: allows an instance URL with a private/internal address.
Optional: Secret Token des GitLab-Webhoo: Optional: secret token of the GitLab webhook (issue events, X-Gitlab-Token). Without a token the webhook endpoint stays disabled; polling catches up on everything.
Project Access Token (empfohlen) oder Pe: Project access token (recommended) or personal access token with the read_api scope.
Schließt das verknüpfte Issue (mit Notiz: Closes the linked issue (with a note) when the task is completed in workDiary and reopens it when the task is reopened. Title and description remain owned by the source system. The token needs write access to issues (api scope).
